opportunities.title: APEX Awards
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Established independent researchers with a strong track record, holding a permanent or fixed-term position covering the duration of the award, with teaching and admin duties, based in a UK University or UK not-for-profit research organisation. Up to two Co-applicants from different Academy remits.
opportunities.summary: Cross-Academy scheme (British Academy, Royal Society, Royal Academy of Engineering, supported by Leverhulme Trust) offering established independent researchers up to £200,000 for genuine interdisciplinary, curiosity-driven research across science, engineering, social sciences and humanities, held for up to 24 months.

opportunities.title: SHAPE Involve and Engage
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Open to any researcher based in the UK who meets the conditions of the call; prior public engagement experience expected; previous successful recipients not eligible to reapply.
opportunities.summary: Public engagement programme supporting ambitious projects (up to £8,000) to engage the public with the humanities and social sciences, working in partnership with a GLAM organisation or performing arts organisation.

opportunities.title: The Alexander von Humboldt Foundation and The British Academy Knowledge Frontiers Symposium 2027

amount.raw: The symposium covers travel, accommodation, and visa costs

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Early career researchers affiliated with research institutions in the UK or Germany, in the humanities and social sciences.
opportunities.summary: Call for early career researchers in the humanities and social sciences to attend a research collaboration symposium on the theme 'Humans and Nature: More resilient towards the future', held 21-23 April 2027, with seed funding available for international collaborations.

opportunities.title: Postdoctoral Fellowships

amount.raw: 80% of salary costs, directly allocated and indirect costs under FEC; three years

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Early-career researchers in the humanities and social sciences based at an eligible UK university or research organisation. British citizens and EEA nationals eligible regardless of doctorate origin; anyone with a UK doctorate eligible; Viva Voce completed between 1 April 2024 and 1 April 2027; must not have held a permanent academic post.
opportunities.summary: Three-year Postdoctoral Fellowship for outstanding early-career researchers in the humanities or social sciences to pursue an independent research project towards a significant piece of publishable research, funded by DSIT.

opportunities.title: Talent Development Awards 2026-27
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Established researchers in the humanities and social sciences ordinarily resident in the UK, holding a current long-term appointment at a UK-based HEI or IRO continuing for the full duration of the award.
opportunities.summary: Awards to promote acquisition and advancement of skills (quantitative skills, data science, digital humanities, languages) by UK-based researchers, supporting innovative research methods through skills development, collaboration or dissemination, for 6-12 months.

opportunities.title: International Interdisciplinary Research Projects 2027

amount.raw: up to £300,000 over 2 years (80% FEC; total project value at 100% FEC up to £375,000)

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Principal Investigator must be a researcher from the humanities and social sciences based at an eligible UK university or research institute, of postdoctoral or above status, spending at least 20% time on the award; overseas Co-Applicants required; genuinely interdisciplinary collaboration required.
opportunities.summary: International Interdisciplinary Research programme supporting projects led by UK-based humanities/social sciences researchers with international partners, on the theme of Mobilities, across SHAPE and STEM disciplines, for 24 months.

opportunities.title: Global Innovation Fellowships: The German Council on Foreign Relations (DGAP) 2026-27
opportunities.eligibility_summary: UK-based early- and mid-career researchers from across the humanities and social sciences.
opportunities.summary: Global Innovation Fellowships offering up to two one-year fellowships for UK-based early/mid-career researchers to embed in the office of the German Council on Foreign Relations (DGAP) in Berlin, developing skills, networks and careers in policy sectors.

opportunities.title: Additional Needs
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Current British Academy award-holders or applicants intending to apply for a British Academy award in the next six months; must meet the eligibility requirements of the scheme they intend to apply for.
opportunities.summary: Funding to support additional needs that applicants and award-holders may require (e.g. equipment to overcome barriers for disabled researchers, caring costs for research trips, assistance with applications), considered on a case-by-case basis on a rolling deadline.

opportunities.title: British Academy/Leverhulme Small Research Grants
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Postdoctoral scholars (or equivalent) ordinarily resident in the United Kingdom; applications require approval of employing institution; independent scholars eligible; Principal Applicant must be ordinarily resident in the UK.
opportunities.summary: Small Research Grants up to £10,000, tenable for up to 24 months, to cover expenses arising from a defined research project in the humanities and social sciences. Scheme opens 2 September 2026 with deadline 4 November 2026.
